summary: Iteration 15 verified the tiny follow-up change: PRICING section on landing page (index.tsx) is now gated by Platform.OS === 'web'. Web regression (mobile viewport 375x667, logged OUT) confirms all pricing content ($15/$25/$35 cards, LEARN/ADVANCED/PRO tiers, 7-day money-back guarantee line, 'see refund policy' link) still renders on web preview. FAQ, CONTACT and footer (Terms/Privacy/Refunds testIDs) all render. Continue with Google + Continue with Email buttons present; email form opens showing email-input, password-input, email-submit-btn. Logged-in check (localStorage session_token=demo_token_active) redirects from '/' to tabs UI (SESSIONS/ANALYSE/PROFILE tabs visible, 'YOUR SESSIONS.' rendered). Backend smoke: /api/health 200, /api/plans 200 returning 4 plans (free, learn, advanced, pro), / returns 200 HTML from static_web export. Code inspection of /app/frontend/app/index.tsx confirms the Platform.OS === 'web' conditional wraps the PRICING View from line 369 to closing `)}` on line 444; FAQ/Contact/Footer are outside the conditional and always render. Balanced JSX braces, lint passes per main agent. Native iOS build will therefore hide pricing (not testable in browser as Platform.OS is 'web').
